args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: After checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed, it failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. We tried to roll back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that had been healthy in production, but the system rejected it because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417). We then rolled back to v2.2.9, the next most recent release that had been healthy in production, in all regions. After the rollback the service is healthy, with an error rate of about 0.2%. Follow-ups: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, and confirm whether CVE-2026-4417 affects v2.2.9. v2.2.9 is not quarantined, but this has not been checked. Ship a fixed release that includes the CVE fix.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to **v2.2.9** in all regions and is healthy again. That's one release older than you asked for, because the newest healthy release can't be used.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Why not v2.3.0:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, but the rollback was rejected because that version is quarantined for a security issue (CVE-2026-4417).
- **What I did instead:** I rolled back to v2.2.9, the next most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, and the error rate is down to 0.2%. No approval was needed because v2.2.9 has been healthy in production before.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It explains why v2.3.0 was skipped for v2.2.9 and lists follow-ups: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, check whether the security issue also affects v2.2.9, and ship a fixed release.

v2.2.9 isn't quarantined, but nobody has checked whether the security issue affects it too, so that check should be done soon.
